description: GPTIMG2 is an AI image and video generation workspace built for teams that need production-ready visuals instead of novelty-only outputs. It focuses on prompt fidelity, cleaner on-image text, reference-led editing, and a workflow that moves from still-image generation into downstream video and campaign production. That makes GPTIMG2 especially useful for product marketing, ecommerce, social creative, posters, menus, diagrams, thumbnails, and other asset-heavy workflows where revision control mat
